data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to retrieve the Android device ID on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: Provides a method to obtain the Android ID, returning it as a nullable string. On non‑Android platforms it returns null, and on Android it may throw MissingPluginException if not registered correctly.
use_when: You need a unique identifier per device/app signing key on Android
You want a simple, no‑dependency way to access Android ID
avoid_when: You need an identifier that persists across app reinstallations or factory resets
strengths: Handles Android‑specific ID nuances and provides defensive usage examples
No extra native setup beyond standard Flutter Android configuration
weaknesses: Android ID may change after factory reset or signing key change
data.minimal_example:
const _androidIdPlugin = AndroidId();
final String? androidId = await _androidIdPlugin.getId();
